name: memarium
description: Turn your Claude Code + VS Code Copilot Chat + Codex sessions into per-project typed memory — episodic / semantic / procedural / core memory, a personal entity wiki, and distilled Q&A — then auto-load the project primer at the start of every session so a new session already knows the project (architecture, setup, gotchas, rules). Standalone Claude Code plugin. Optional memarium npm CLI for cross-device sync.
